component.name: Chumby Emulator
component.summary: Run a Chumby Classic on your desktop, in QEMU

description.p: The Chumby Classic, emulated by QEMU with qemu-chumby's chumby-classic machine (Freescale i.MX21, ARM926), in one window: its touch screen, drawn sharp at any size, the top button, the accelerometer, headphones, sound, a USB keyboard and stick, and its serial console.
It boots your own Chumby's kernel and flash images, which it does not include. The emulated Chumby has no network.
The first Flatpak: chumby-desktop with qemu-chumby's QEMU inside it.
